name: pymrr
summary: pymrr (Multi-Mechanism Runoff and Routing): a distributed, physics-based hydrological + hydrodynamic model — DEM preprocessing, gauge/IMERG precipitation, VSA + Green-Ampt + impervious runoff generation, and kinematic/diffusive-wave/Muskingum–Cunge/local-inertial dynamic-wave routing, with optional Google Earth Engine forcing and CPU/GPU backends.
